shipping.hero_title:
Delivering your orders
with ease and safety
shipping.hero_desc: At ShoppyGo, we ensure your order reaches you quickly and safely, from order confirmation right to your doorstep.
shipping.choose_suitable_method: Choose the right method for you
shipping.methods_desc: We provide flexible shipping options to ensure your orders arrive in the fastest and most convenient way.
shipping.standard_desc: Your order is delivered to the specified address during checkout within the expected timeframe.
shipping.free_desc: Enjoy free shipping during special campaigns and promotional offers on ShoppyGo.
shipping.process_desc: From order confirmation to delivery, we ensure a smooth and transparent shopping experience.
shipping.step1_desc: Complete your order and select your delivery address and preferred payment method.
shipping.step2_desc: Our team carefully prepares and packages your items for shipment.
shipping.step3_desc: Your order is handed over to our shipping partner for delivery.
shipping.step4_desc: Your package arrives at your door and you can pay on delivery.
shipping.info_desc: At ShoppyGo, we strive to offer a simple and reliable delivery experience across all Egyptian governorates through our trusted partners.
shipping.delivery_duration_desc: 2 to 5 business days depending on delivery location.
shipping.shipping_fees_desc: Current shipping fee is 50 EGP per order, with free shipping promotions available periodically.
shipping.delivery_areas_desc: We deliver to all governorates across Egypt.
shipping.your_order_on_way: Your order is on its way
shipping.cod_desc: You can select Cash on Delivery during checkout and pay for your items and shipping upon arrival.
shipping.tracking_desc: Once your order is shipped, you can track its status and updates directly from your ShoppyGo account.
shipping.faq_desc: Here are answers to the most frequently asked questions about shipping and delivery.
shipping.faq1_a: Delivery usually takes 2 to 5 business days, depending on your governorate and address.
shipping.faq2_q: How much is the shipping fee?
shipping.faq2_a: The current shipping fee is 50 EGP per order. Special free shipping offers may apply during promotional periods.
shipping.faq3_a: Yes, ShoppyGo offers promotional campaigns with free shipping on select orders or products according to offer terms.
shipping.faq4_a: Yes, you can choose Cash on Delivery if available for your order and delivery area.
shipping.faq5_q: Do you deliver to all Egyptian governorates?
shipping.faq5_a: Yes, we provide delivery services across all governorates in Egypt.
shipping.faq6_a: Yes, you can track your order status from the 'My Orders' section in your account after dispatch.
shipping.cta_desc: Explore your favorite products and enjoy an effortless shopping experience with reliable delivery from ShoppyGo.

return_request.hero_title:
Return your order
with ease and confidence
return_request.hero_desc: We want you to have the best shopping experience. If your purchase is not right for you, you can submit a return request within 14 days of receiving your order.
return_request.conditions_desc: Please make sure your order meets the following return conditions to ensure a smooth and quick process.
return_request.condition_1_desc: The return request must be submitted within 14 days from the date you receive the order.
return_request.condition_2_desc: The product must be unused and returned in its original condition with its packaging and accessories.
return_request.condition_3_desc: Not all products are eligible for return. Eligibility may vary depending on the product category and its condition.
return_request.condition_4_desc: Some products cannot be returned due to their nature or applicable return conditions.
return_request.return_in_steps: Return your order in 4 simple steps
return_request.process_desc: Our return process is designed to be simple, clear and easy to follow.
return_request.step1_desc: Choose the order and product you want to return from your orders list.
return_request.step2_desc: Select the reason for the return and provide the required information.
return_request.step3_desc: After approval, our shipping partner will arrange the pickup of the product.
return_request.step4_desc: After receiving and reviewing the product, your refund will be processed.
return_request.start_desc: Select the order you want to return and follow the simple steps to submit your request.
return_request.select_order_desc: Choose the order you want to return
return_request.select_reason_desc: Tell us why you want to return it
return_request.reason_size: Size or color is not suitable
return_request.reason_not_needed: I no longer need the product
return_request.refund_title: How will you receive your refund?
return_request.refund_desc: Once your return is approved and the product is received and reviewed, the refund amount can be sent using one of the available methods.
return_request.bank_transfer_desc: Receive your refund directly through your bank account.
return_request.wallet_desc: Receive your refund through a supported electronic wallet.
return_request.refund_after_approval: After return approval and product review
return_request.tracking_desc: Follow every step of your return request directly from your ShoppyGo account.
return_request.faq_desc: Here are answers to the most frequently asked questions about returns and refunds.
return_request.faq1_q: How many days do I have to return a product?
return_request.faq1_a: You can submit a return request within 14 days from the date you receive your order.
return_request.faq2_q: Can I return a used product?
return_request.faq2_a: No. The product must be unused and returned in its original condition with its original packaging and accessories.
return_request.faq3_q: Are all products eligible for return?
return_request.faq3_a: No. Some products may not be eligible for return depending on their category, nature or applicable return conditions.
return_request.faq4_a: Yes. Return shipping is free for eligible return requests according to ShoppyGo's return conditions.
return_request.faq5_q: How will I receive my refund?
return_request.faq5_a: You can receive your refund through a bank transfer or a supported electronic wallet.
return_request.faq6_q: Can I track my return request?
return_request.faq6_a: Yes. You can track the status of your return request from your ShoppyGo account.
return_request.need_help_desc: If you have any questions about your return request, our support team is ready to help you.

better shopping experience

terms.account_point2: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account.
terms.account_point3: You should notify us if you notice any unauthorized access to your account.
terms.orders_desc: When you place an order through ShoppyGo, you agree that the information provided during checkout is accurate and complete.
terms.orders_point1: Orders are subject to product availability.
terms.orders_point2: We reserve the right to accept or cancel an order when necessary.
terms.orders_point3: Product prices and availability may change without prior notice.
terms.orders_point4: Order confirmation does not always guarantee final acceptance of the order.
terms.payment_desc: ShoppyGo supports the payment methods displayed during checkout, including Cash on Delivery when available for your order and delivery area.

terms.payment_point2: Cash on Delivery is available only when shown as an option during checkout.
terms.payment_point3: Any applicable shipping fees or additional charges will be displayed before completing the order.
terms.shipping_desc: We aim to deliver your orders safely and within the estimated delivery period. Delivery services are currently available across Egypt.
terms.shipping_point1: The estimated delivery time is usually 2–5 business days.
terms.shipping_point2: The standard shipping fee is currently 50 EGP per order.
terms.shipping_point3: Free shipping may be available during promotional offers.
terms.shipping_point4: Delivery times may vary depending on the delivery address and other circumstances.

terms.returns_point2: Some products may not be eligible for return or replacement.

terms.returns_point4: Return requests must follow the applicable return conditions and procedures.
terms.product_desc: We work to provide accurate product information, descriptions, prices, and images. However, some details may vary slightly from the actual product.
terms.content_desc: All content available on ShoppyGo, including text, images, logos, designs, and other materials, is protected by applicable intellectual property laws unless otherwise stated.

terms.content_point2: You may not copy, reproduce, modify, or distribute our content without permission.

terms.prohibited_desc: To keep ShoppyGo safe and reliable for everyone, the following activities are not allowed:
terms.prohibited_point1: Using the website for illegal purposes.
terms.prohibited_point3: Attempting to access accounts or systems without authorization.
terms.prohibited_point4: Interfering with the operation or security of the website.
terms.prohibited_point5: Using automated tools to collect or misuse website data without permission.

terms.liability_desc: ShoppyGo aims to provide a reliable shopping experience, but we are not responsible for losses resulting from circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including delivery delays, technical problems, or third-party services.
terms.changes_desc: We may update these Terms of Use from time to time to reflect changes to our services, policies, or legal requirements. Updated terms will be published on this page.
terms.contact_desc: If you have any questions about these Terms of Use, please contact our support team through the available contact channels on ShoppyGo.
terms.agree_message: By continuing to use ShoppyGo, you acknowledge that you have read and understood these Terms of Use.

help_center.faq1_q: How can I place an order?

help_center.faq2_q: How can I track my order?
help_center.faq2_a: You can track your order from the My Orders section in your ShoppyGo account after your order has been shipped.
help_center.faq3_a: Delivery usually takes between 2 and 5 business days depending on your delivery address.
help_center.faq4_a: The current standard shipping fee is 50 EGP per order. Free shipping may be available during promotional offers.

return_policy.hero_title:
Shop with Confidence with Complete
Flexibility in Returns & Exchanges
return_policy.hero_desc: At ShoppyGo, your complete satisfaction is our goal. You can easily return or exchange your purchases under the following terms.
return_policy.conditions_desc: To ensure your return request is processed smoothly and without delays, please verify:
return_policy.cond1_desc: Product must be in its original box and unopened packaging with all accessories.
return_policy.cond2_desc: All original price tags and labels must remain attached without removal.
return_policy.cond3_desc: Possession of the order number or official electronic invoice from ShoppyGo.
return_policy.cond4_desc: Item must not have been used, tested, or worn in any way.
return_policy.steps_title: 4 Simple Steps to Return Your Order
return_policy.steps_desc: Clear and direct steps starting from your account to receiving your refund.
return_policy.step1_desc: Go to 'My Orders', select the item, and click on 'Request Return'.
return_policy.step2_desc: A courier will contact you to pick up the shipment within 2-4 business days.
return_policy.step3_desc: The product arrives at our warehouse to verify compliance with return conditions.
return_policy.step4_desc: Funds are credited back to you immediately upon successful quality check.
return_policy.non_returnable_subtitle: For hygiene and safety reasons, the following items cannot be returned:
return_policy.non2: Opened personal care and beauty products.
return_policy.non3: Digital software and gift cards after delivery.
return_policy.non4: Customized or personalized items made on request.
return_policy.refund_methods_subtitle: How and when do you get your money back?
return_policy.ref_card_desc: Refunded to the same payment card within 5 to 14 business days depending on your bank.
return_policy.ref_cod_desc: Added as store credit in your ShoppyGo wallet instantly or transferred to your bank/e-wallet.
return_policy.faq_desc: Here are answers to the most common questions from our customers.
return_policy.faq1_a: If the return is due to a manufacturing defect or an error by ShoppyGo, we cover all shipping costs. If returning by personal preference, shipping fees will be deducted.
return_policy.faq2_q: How long does a refund take?
return_policy.faq2_a: It usually takes 3 to 7 business days from the moment the returned package arrives at our warehouse and passes inspection.
return_policy.faq3_q: Can I exchange an item for a different one?
return_policy.faq3_a: Yes, you can request an exchange for a different size or color, or substitute it for another item by paying or refunding the price difference.
return_policy.faq4_q: What if I receive a damaged item?
return_policy.faq4_a: Please contact support immediately or submit a return request within 48 hours of receipt along with photos of the damaged item.
return_policy.cta_title: Need help with a return request?
return_policy.cta_desc: Our customer support team is available anytime to assist you through the process.

privacy_policy.hero_title:
Your Personal Data is Completely Safe
With ShoppyGo
privacy_policy.hero_desc: We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the safety of your personal information while shopping on our platform with full transparency.
privacy_policy.hl_2_sub: Manage and edit your data anytime
privacy_policy.hl_3_sub: Your data is never sold to anyone
privacy_policy.pillars_title: How We Handle Your Data at ShoppyGo
privacy_policy.pillars_desc: We guarantee total transparency in how your personal information is collected and used.
privacy_policy.p1_desc: We only collect data necessary to fulfill and deliver your orders, such as name, address, and phone number.
privacy_policy.p2_desc: We use your preferences to display the most relevant deals and products tailored for you.
privacy_policy.p3_desc: Your basic info is shared strictly with delivery partners and payment gateways to process orders.
privacy_policy.p4_desc: We use cookies to save your shopping cart and make sign-ins fast and effortless.
privacy_policy.collect_subtitle: Types of information required to complete your shopping experience
privacy_policy.col_1_d: Full name, email address, phone number, and detailed shipping address.
privacy_policy.col_2_d: Payment details (processed fully encrypted through certified payment processors; we do not store card numbers).
privacy_policy.col_3_d: IP address and device type to help secure your account and detect fraudulent activity.
privacy_policy.rights_subtitle: What you can do with your registered data with us
privacy_policy.right_1_d: You can update your personal information and delivery addresses at any time from your account settings.
privacy_policy.right_2_d: You have the right to request permanent deletion of your account and all associated data.
privacy_policy.right_3_d: You can unsubscribe from promotional emails and marketing alerts with a single click.
privacy_policy.faq_desc: Direct answers to common questions about your data security.
privacy_policy.faq1_q: Is my credit card information stored on ShoppyGo?
privacy_policy.faq1_a: No, we never store your bank card numbers. Payments are processed securely via encrypted, fully certified payment gateways.
privacy_policy.faq2_q: Will my phone number be shared with telemarketers?
privacy_policy.faq2_a: Absolutely not. Your phone number and email will never be shared with third-party advertisers.
privacy_policy.faq3_q: How can I delete all my data from the platform?
privacy_policy.faq3_a: You can request account deletion from your profile settings or contact our privacy support team, and your data will be erased within 48 hours.
privacy_policy.faq4_q: What is the purpose of cookies?
privacy_policy.faq4_a: Cookies help us remember items in your cart and ensure a smoother, faster browsing experience tailored to your preferences.
privacy_policy.cta_desc: Our data protection team is ready to answer any questions regarding your information security.

terms_conditions.hero_desc: Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully before using our platform. Your use of the website constitutes full acceptance of all terms listed below.
terms_conditions.pillars_desc: A summary of the primary rules and policies governing your shopping experience on our platform.
terms_conditions.p1_desc: You must be at least 18 years old to place orders independently and hold full responsibility for keeping your account credentials secure.
terms_conditions.p2_desc: All placed orders are subject to acceptance and stock availability. We reserve the right to decline any order at our discretion.
terms_conditions.p3_desc: All prices are displayed in the local currency and are inclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise in product details.
terms_conditions.p4_desc: All content, trademarks, logos, and graphics displayed on ShoppyGo are exclusive property of the website and protected by law.
terms_conditions.details_1_sub: Rules to adhere to while using the platform
terms_conditions.resp_1_d: Users commit to providing fully accurate details (such as shipping address and phone number) to ensure successful order delivery.
terms_conditions.resp_2_d: It is strictly prohibited to use the platform for unlawful purposes or attempt to breach/disrupt site operations.
terms_conditions.resp_3_d: Users are responsible for updating any changes to their personal information through their account dashboard.
terms_conditions.details_2_sub: Legal limits of ShoppyGo regarding service delivery
terms_conditions.liab_1_d: We strive to ensure accurate stock levels, but rare exceptions may require order cancellation or adjustment with full refunds.
terms_conditions.liab_2_d: We are not liable for delays caused by force majeure events or third-party courier delays beyond our reasonable control.
terms_conditions.liab_3_d: Service may be temporarily suspended for scheduled maintenance or system upgrades to improve user experience.
terms_conditions.faq_desc: Direct answers to the most common questions about our terms of use.
terms_conditions.faq1_q: Can these Terms and Conditions be updated?
terms_conditions.faq1_a: Yes, ShoppyGo reserves the right to amend these terms at any time. Significant updates will be communicated via email or site notices.
terms_conditions.faq2_q: What happens if a product is mispriced?
terms_conditions.faq2_a: If a pricing error occurs on an item you ordered, our team will seek your confirmation at the correct price or cancel the order with a full refund.
terms_conditions.faq3_a: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate our terms, engage in fraudulent activities, or place fake orders.
terms_conditions.faq4_q: What governing law applies in disputes?
terms_conditions.faq4_a: All terms and conditions and any resulting disputes shall be governed by the applicable local state laws and courts.
terms_conditions.cta_title: Have questions about our legal terms?
terms_conditions.cta_desc: Contact our legal support and customer care team for clarification and assistance.

orders_delivery.question: How long does order delivery take in Egypt?
orders_delivery.answer: Delivery usually takes 24 to 48 hours within Cairo & Giza, and 2-4 business days for other governorates via Bosta shipping.

track_order.question: How can I track my shipment status?
track_order.answer: You can track your order status by visiting 'My Orders' in your account or by clicking the tracking link sent via SMS and Email.

payment_methods.question: What payment options are available on ShoppyGo?
payment_methods.answer: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa & MasterCard), Mobile Wallets (Vodafone Cash, etc.), and Meeza via Paymob gateway.

cash_on_delivery.question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) supported?
cash_on_delivery.answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for most locations across Egypt during checkout.

return_policy.question: What is your return and exchange policy?
return_policy.answer: You can return or exchange items within 14 days of delivery provided the product is unused and in its original packaging.

refund_time.question: How long does a refund take to process?
refund_time.answer: Card refunds take 5-10 business days depending on your bank. COD refunds are sent instantly to your Mobile Wallet upon item inspection.

create_account.question: Do I need an account to place an order?
create_account.answer: Creating an account helps you track your orders, save delivery addresses, and receive exclusive promotional offers.

reset_password.question: What should I do if I forgot my password?
reset_password.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and we will send a password reset link to your registered email address.
